title: Obese Armored Sorcerer
description: A massively obese man with pale skin and numerous tattoos sits on a dark throne, wearing black spiked armor with purple accents and a golden book crown. He is surrounded by floating magical papers, lit candles, and arcane symbols in a fiery purple and orange cavernous setting.
prompt: A massively obese pale-skinned man with a large belly covered in detailed tattoos sits heavily on a dark stone throne carved with runes. He wears ornate black spiked armor with purple glowing runes and a golden book on his head like a crown. Floating around him are many aged papers with arcane symbols and text like 'NOT TODAY' and 'SPELLFORGE ARMORY'. The background is a fiery purple and orange cavern with floating embers and candles at his feet.
